description: Erection of a two storey rear extension to both buildings and formation of vehicle access to the front of the building
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Location Plan, ASB724 - 01FPA1, ASB724 - 02FPA1; received 06/04/2020
ASB724 - 07FPA1 A, ASB724 - 05FPA1 A, ASB724 - 03FPA1 A, ASB724 - 04FPA1 A; received 26/08/2020
ASB724 - 06FPA1 A, ASB724 - 08FPA1; received 24/09/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The 600mm wall shown on drawing number ASB724 - 06FPA1 A received 24/09/2020 shall be installed prior to use and retained thereafter.
